title: Abajugunywe mu ijuru
intro: Ikiremwa cy’amayobera gihagaze mu nzira y’irema n’iyangwa. Inkuru yabo ni ubwirasi budasanzwe no kwigomeka ku itegeko ry’Imana. Amahitamo yabo agaragara mu bisekuru byose, akaba ikizamini kuri buri roho yavukiye muri iyi si. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu mwanzi w’iteka ryose?
clues: Nari ndi mu gikorwa cy’ingenzi cyane ku isi, ubwo ikiremwa gishya cyaremwaga mu ibumba kigahabwa ubuzima n’umwuka w’Imbabazi.
Nanjye ubwanjye naremwe nturutse ku kintu kimwe gika umuriro, bitandukanye n'icyo cyaremwe mu mukungugu.
Hatanzwe itegeko nabonaga ko riri munsi y'aho nkorera.
Ubwibone bwaranyibagiwe, maze ndanga rwose gukurikiza iryo tegeko.
Nahawe gutinda kugeza ku munsi wagenwe, kugira ngo nkomeze umugambi wanjye wo kuyobya abandi.
Ndi umwanzi w’abantu bose bagenda ku isi, nvugana uburiganya kandi nkabakurura mu nzira igororotse.
